Establish ST-01 by confirming in the test fixture that the OTP is bound to A, is within the implementation-configured validity period, and is unused. Select a new password that satisfies FR-01. At workflow level, any confirmation value equals the new password; no confirmation field is added to the API body.
Request Input: Send one application/json POST request with body {"email":"account-a@domain.com","resetToken":"<OTP generated for account A>","newPassword":"NewPassword123!"}.
Expected Result: Under the reviewed external HTTP oracle, the request returns 200 OK. The intended account-password reset occurs and the used OTP enters ST-03, so it is invalidated for later use. Do not assert any response body, message, header, session effect, notification, or exact persistence/invalidation ordering.
